_comment: Edit this, then run.bat. Use 'node src/index.js --list-devices' and '--list-processes' to find values.

incoming._sourceNote: 'system' = all desktop audio, works with ANY game, no setup. 'process' = one app only.
incoming._speakSameLanguageNote: false = stay silent when they already speak your language. Leave false.
incoming._playbackDeviceNote: Empty = Windows default (your headphones). Where you HEAR translations.
incoming._targetLanguageNote: Leave EMPTY to use this computer's language automatically. Or set a code: en, es, de, ru, pt, fr...

outgoing._micDeviceNote: Empty = auto-pick. Or paste an exact name from --list-devices.
outgoing._targetNote: Anything other than 'en' needs translate.backend = 'llama' and a running llama-server.
outgoing._playbackDeviceNote: The virtual mic the game reads. Set the game's mic input to 'CABLE Output'.

vad._thresholdNote: 0.5 quiet rooms, 0.7 games, 0.85 heavy gunfire. Higher = fewer false triggers.
vad._minRmsNote: Utterances quieter than this are discarded before whisper sees them.

filters._repeatNote: Same text inside this window is dropped. Kills hallucination loops.
filters._maxAgeNote: Utterances older than this are dropped rather than spoken late.

whisper._modelNote: ggml-medium.bin is far more accurate on names and slang, but ~3x slower.
whisper._extraArgsNote: LEAVE EMPTY. Adding '-ng' disables the GPU and makes everything ~10x slower.

translate._backendNote: 'whisper' = free, local, ENGLISH OUTPUT ONLY. 'llama' = any language, needs llama-server on :8080.

tts._voicesNote: Only files that actually exist are used. Missing ones are ignored unless that language is your target.

debug._logLevelNote: 'debug' shows filtered and skipped utterances too.
